_contract.purpose: Frozen consumer contract for equipment delta folding (lane 4 §2.6). Deltas overlay js/battle-simulator-equipment-catalog.js — they never edit it. Unverified deltas are excluded from resolveEquipmentLoadout but remain visible in the Field Data panel.
rules: Key by equipmentId and/or setId; a delta may cover one piece, one set, or a family.
value is a numeric delta applied to the referenced stat field.
relatedDuelRecordIds links the delta to duel records in duel-records.json for the evidence trail.
verificationStatus unverified means excluded from simulations; no exceptions.
Provenance 5-field envelope required on every record.
